name: Fan of Seven Debts' On Enter draws a card
notes: Fan of Seven Debts' element is NORM, so no lineage patch is needed, and its memory cost (1) is NOT exercised for the same FSM-click-bypass reason as entrancing-filigree-enter-banish.
